entities.summary: A signed near-loop from Nida’s lagoon edge through low dune country, pine forest and the Baltic shore to the old Curonian cemetery.
entities.description: Walk the official lower point-to-point route from the Neringa Sport School signboard to the old cemetery in Skruzdynė. It follows the Curonian Lagoon around the base of Parnidis rather than climbing to the sundial, then crosses pine forest and the Baltic shore before returning through dune woodland. The route nearly encircles Nida, but its signed endpoints are different: it is not a closed loop and the walk back through town is extra.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The route compresses the Curonian Spit’s unusual lagoon, pine, dune and Baltic landscapes into one varied half-day walk without requiring a car or an exposed summit detour.

values.accessPointNote: Reach Nida by current bus/ferry connections or park in town, then walk to the board. Vehicle-entry and summer parking fees are separate and date-sensitive; the park visitor ticket is voluntary.
values.bestSeason: Choose settled weather and enough daylight; official pages do not provide a live route-status feed, so check notices before setting out.
values.crowding: Nida and the shore are busiest in summer; the forest sections usually feel quieter.
values.exposure: Low fall exposure; open shore sections are exposed to wind, sun and rapidly changing coastal weather.
values.recommendedVariant: The signed lower Sport School–old cemetery route around the base of Parnidis, not the summit variation and not a closed town loop.
values.technicality: Nontechnical walking, but soft sand, steps and several slopes make normal hiking footwear worthwhile.
values.trailheadCoordinatePrecision: Exact OSM node at the signed route start by Neringa Sport School.

variants.name: Neringa Sport School to the old cemetery
variants.description: The signed lower route around Nida, ending at the old cemetery; it is not a closed loop through town and does not climb the Parnidis summit variation.

trailhead.name: Neringa Sport School route board
trailhead.note: The signed route starts on the path behind the sport school; vehicles cannot reach the board.

finish.name: Old Curonian cemetery route board
finish.note: The official finish is by the old cemetery in Skruzdynė; returning to the start through Nida adds roughly 1.5–2 km.

variants.accessNotes: Nida bus station is a practical town access point and the municipality publishes date-specific schedules; walk through Nida to the sport-school board. The board itself is not drive-up. On 1 September 2026 the passenger-car entry toll is €10 (the lower 21 August–19 June rate), while Nida’s seasonal paid-parking period ended on 31 August; always recheck both volatile charges. The hike has no mandatory trail admission, and the national park’s €1 visitor ticket is voluntary.
variants.seasonalLimitations: The current official route pages list the itinerary but provide no day-specific open/closed status, so this record does not claim that every section is open. Check current notices and obey barriers. Wind, heat, soft sand, snow or ice can materially change difficulty.
variants.waterAvailability: Use Nida shops and services before starting; do not rely on a drinking-water source along the forest, dune or shore sections.
suitabilityConstraints: Not step-free: the route includes sand, forest surfaces, slopes and steps.
Soft sand can be tiring despite the low elevation profile.
The official endpoints differ; the return through town is additional distance.
warnings: Stay on the signed route and never cross reserve boundary markers or barriers; the dune and reserve habitats are fragile.
Cross road 167 only at the mapped crossing and remain alert around shared cycle and town paths.
This OSM-derived centerline is descriptive, not navigation-grade; current signs and restrictions always win.
Do not substitute the Parnidis summit/sundial variation or an improvised closed loop for this published lower route.
